title: Instrumentation playbook - Glanceboard assets for latency / cost / trace views
creator: Sophia Alvarez
description: Design a compact ‘Glanceboard’ set of onboarding screenshots and help-card visuals that demonstrate how Redwood Console surfaces latency distributions, cost-per-token breakdowns, and request trace flows. The goal is a consumable asset pack for docs, release notes, and the in-product quickstart carousel that shows: (1) default latency SLO panel, (2) token-level cost heatmap, (3) single-request trace swimlane with KV-cache markers, and (4) an expandable annotate mode for callouts and suggestions.
design_notes: Use existing console color tokens; latency accent = --redwood-latency, cost accent = --redwood-gold
Compact charts: prefer sparkline + percentile band (p50/p95/p99) for quick comprehension
Trace swimlane should show asynchronously loaded KV-cache markers and a dotted fallback path when cache miss occurs
Include an annotation overlay state for the quickstart carousel that highlights three recommended user actions
Create mobile-responsive variants at 360px and 768px widths; crop hero screenshot for marketing use
acceptance_criteria: Three hero screenshots exported at 2x PNG and 1x PNG for desktop and mobile
Design annotations match PM-approved callouts and reference wording from the quickstart copy doc
Figma file contains annotated components and tokens documented with specs for engineering handoff
Assets uploaded to Drive and linked in the PR; QA signoff from Eng and PM in comments
Accessibility check: color contrast for percentile bands meets AA for text overlays
